hold_text: Edits .github/workflows/pr-landing-hold-merge-alarm.yml, the post-merge landing alarm; the manager merges.
why: WHY: at 18:15Z the alarm paged the operator's channel with three FALSE 'merged with no recorded approval: no .github/pr-landing declaration exists' alarms, for automated PRs #27406 and #27399 (research-queue stamps) and #27416 (results batch). All three DID carry a landing file (tier 1, landing self), present on main. Cause: run 44584862177 was triggered at 18:09:55Z for push d6cc77bb3 and checked out that sha, but its job sat in the runner queue until 18:14:59Z. Since #27315 a run grades every PR merged in the last 6 h, so it listed the three PRs merged 18:13-18:14Z and looked for their declarations in a tree that predates them (git merge-base: d6cc77bb3 contains none of their merge commits) -> MISSING -> alarm. WHAT: read each graded PR's declaration at its own merge commit (GET contents?ref=<merge_commit_sha>, raw). A 404 there is a real MISSING (still alarms). Any other failed read, or no merge sha, falls back to the local file, and if that is absent too it reads UNREADABLE (not final: unlabelled, retried next run), never MISSING. Grading, the label dedupe and ping delivery are unchanged. Checks: YAML parses; bash -n on the extracted run block; a stubbed-gh simulation of the four branches (found -> merged decl, 404 -> MISSING, 502 -> UNREADABLE, no merge sha -> UNREADABLE); workflow-actor-guard, workflow-failure-swallow and infra-workflows-single-owner OK. This narrows false pages and removes no alarm path. Gates this adds or changes: none.
